channel.title: Robusta Coffee Monitor
channel.description: Daily model-driven read on coffee markets and Vietnamese Central Highlands growing conditions.

item.title: Coffee monitor — 2026-11-27 — crisis
item.description: Coffee futures closed at 276¢/lb — down 2.3% on the week and down 3.9% on the month. The regime model reads the market as crisis and has for 52 sessions. Growing conditions look unremarkable: Central Highlands rainfall is near its seasonal norm (-0.7σ). The crop is in its maturation & harvest window, and stage-weighted stress is low. A weakening Brazilian real (+5.7% in a month) raises producers' local-currency revenue per bag — added selling pressure.
